cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Can you approve 'delivery delay' in the newsletter? I don't want our new volunteer blamed for the melted cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then 'storage problem'. Will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Can I put your name under it?

mechanism: A edits a protective newsletter account and supervises its refund language to get an accurate-enough endorsement without naming the volunteer.
confusable: Generic reputation defense lacks S03; A must correct how B proposes documenting the repair.
comparison: Written public account and refund status differ from oral caretaker questioning.
seedUse: Use the radiator cake/storage seed, letting A already know delivery was timely and question a concrete editorial addition.
